node.title: A=1 core-one maximal-degree component localization
node.statement: On the half-distance A=1 sharp-cap face with fixed core s=1 and maximal degree e=2m-1, the residual generator has one unique component of bidegree (2e_*+1,e_*); every other component has bidegree (2e_i,e_i). The residual parameter degree b consumes five units of the exact column-defect budget per degree, so b<=floor(e/5). Maximal separation rank of the full residual generator forces sr(Q_*)>=ceil((e+1)/(b+1)), which is at least five at the official row. Thus separated pullbacks and every rank-at-most-four dominant model are excluded. The generator is geometrically squarefree and all components split disjointly on at least 8m-4 supported slopes and 14m residual domain rows. The rank-at-least-five dominant component remains open.
